results.description:
SHERLOCK HOLMES: THE ULTIMATE COMPLETE COLLECTION AND MORE

This exciting collection includes these great features:
•	The complete texts of all 4 novels and 56 adventures of featuring the world’s most famous detective, Sherlock Holmes.
•	Four additional noncanonical stories by Arthur Conan Doyle.
•	A short biography of Doyle.
•	Links to the audiobooks of all 4 novels and 56 adventures for FREE!
•	Helpful links to radio broadcasts, movies, tv shows, and additional Sherlock books.
•	The price! I challenge you to find any similar collection with more bang for your buck.

All canon titles in this Sherlock Holmes collection, along with their publication date, are listed below.
•	A Study in Scarlet (1887)
•	The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes (1892)
•	The Valley of Fear (1914)
•	The Sign of the Four (1890)
•	The Hound of the Baskervilles (1901)
•	The Memoirs of Sherlock Holmes (1894)
•	The Return of Sherlock Holmes (1905)
•	The Case-Book of Sherlock Holmes (1927)
•	His Last Bow (1927)
